expected_ssd_write.definition: per conversation, the bytes the store builds wrote in the main experiment for the same conversation: the IMPRESS-layout store (written, then rewritten in the reordered layout) and, in the gate and pilot phases, the FullLoad store. Request rows and status files are not included (well below 1 % of the total).

expected_duration.basis: per conversation: the recorded seconds of the IMPRESS requests (x number of IMPRESS-format arms) and of the FullLoad requests, the recorded store writing and activation seconds, and the main experiment's remaining seconds per request; judging is needed only if a generated token differs from the recorded IMPRESS tokens (3.6 h per model, not included in the total)

free_space.rule: do not start when free space < 20 x the largest per-conversation store bundle; rechecked before every conversation

smart.reason: the SMART / health log is an NVMe admin command (root only); this account has no passwordless sudo and no SMART tool is installed

attempts.stderr:
r binary.  [  --namespace-id=<NUM>, -n <NUM> ]   --- (optional) desired namespace
